svg.title: Clairvoyant Architecture Diagram
svg.desc: Request flow from Client through Clairvoyant Proxy (Feature Extractor, ONNX Predictor, SJF Priority Queue) to Ollama backend, with response streaming back.
svg.text: Starvation guard: any request waiting > τ = 3×μ
short is promoted to front regardless of P(Long)
Dispatcher goroutine — serial, one request in-flight at a time
